cases.name: drop_accepted
cases.reason: Acknowledges sends without placing messages in recipient context.

cases.name: reverse_fifo
cases.reason: Reverses findings accepted from the same sender.

cases.name: alternative-spool
cases.reason: Uses a per-recipient append-only JSONL spool, drained under the team lock; no per-message files or receive-side sorting.

cases.name: peer-only-roster
cases.reason: Curator adaptation of the former free-interface-64k alternative to the pinned tool names, fields and 1 MiB limit; keeps its peer-only roster (team_members omits the caller and returns only {id}), which the instruction permits.

cases.name: limit-64k
cases.reason: Rejects messages above 64 KiB instead of the pinned 1 MiB (1048576 UTF-8 byte) limit; size_below/size_at must fail.

cases.name: broadcast-skips-finished
cases.reason: Broadcast silently skips teammates that already finished instead of listing them in failed; broadcast_partial must fail.

cases.name: cancel-retains-mailbox
cases.reason: Keeps the team directory on cancellation, so an accepted undelivered finding stays on disk; cancel_queued's transport-agnostic scan must fail.

cases.name: premature-retry-finish
cases.reason: Previous Oracle turn_end lifecycle closes the mailbox on a retryable provider error while the same Pi worker resumes.

cases.name: truthy-recipient-validation
cases.reason: Repaired lifecycle but previous Oracle truthiness validation: to plus broadcast:false is accepted and delivered.

cases.name: rejected-but-delivered
cases.reason: Reports a rejection for both recipient fields after actually enqueueing the malformed finding; recipient model-input checks must reject it.

cases.name: early-exit
cases.reason: The actual candidate extension import exits its Pi process successfully before required behavioral checks; independent scorer must reject incomplete execution.
